name: Uni-President Enterprises Corp
summary: Uni-President Enterprises Corp. is a broad-based conglomerate primarily focused on the production, processing, and distribution of a wide array of consumer goods across Taiwan, China, and international markets, encompassing foodstuffs, beverages, animal feed and flour, plus diversified ventures in retail, entertainment, and real estate. Established in 1967, the company is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
